messages:
Ava: Quick sync — product benchmark webinar + launch email plan. Need a tight 3-email microdrip for webinar signups, segmented by company size (1-10 / 11-200 / 200+). Also APAC send windows and subject line variants. Drop availability and any blockers? cc @Priya

Diego: On it. My proposal: Starter (1-10) = short wins + trial CTA; Growth (11-200) = case studies + pricing tease; Enterprise (200+) = invite to dedicated demo. I can build the segment queries today.

Priya: APAC note — ideal local send window is 08:00–10:00 SGT. For APAC registrants move Send #1 earlier by ~8–12 hours vs NA. We also need JP/KR translations for copy and subject lines — can we get base copy by Wed so localization team has 48 hrs?

Sam: Quick numbers: Starter ~4.2k, Growth ~1.1k, Enterprise ~320. Deliverability plan: seed tests -> 2-day ramp -> full ramp. Recommend 15-min stagger for large batches on dedicated IP.

Lily: Subject line ideas (short):
- "See Redwood's latency benchmark"
- "How we cut inference costs by 3x"
- "Webinar recap + benchmarking highlights"
Prefer A/B test the first two for Starter/Growth. For Enterprise use a single invite-style subject: "Schedule a private demo: benchmarking results". Also tweak copy: replace 'trial' with 'sandbox' for Enterprise messaging.

Ava: Love the plan. Actions: A) A/B subject lines for Starter & Growth, single for Enterprise; B) Diego — add final segment filters + send lists to the doc; C) Sam — run seed at T-48 and monitoring plan; D) Priya — localization deadline Wed.

Diego: Done — I added segment filters and the query snippet here: https://docs.redwood.xyz/marketing/webinar-seg (private). Snippet: ```sql
-- Starter (1-10)
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE company_size <= 10 AND created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND email_opt_in = true;
```

Schedule (draft):
1) Seed test: Thu 10:00 PT -> 100 internal + engaged addresses
2) Day 0 send: Fri 09:00 PT (Starter A) / 09:15 PT (Starter B)
3) Day 2 follow-up: Sun 09:00 PT (all cohorts)
4) Enterprise demo invites: Mon 10:00 PT (manual QA + human send)

LaunchBot: Reminder: Email QA meeting scheduled Wed 14:00 PT. Calendar invite sent. :calendar:

Sam: Will run deliverability checklist and provide ramp report after seed. :thumbsup:

Ava: Perfect — I'll consolidate into the launch playbook and post updates in the doc. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
